ski: A wet system brings snow to the Washington Cascades Thursday with the snow level near ~4,900 ft, and Saturday dries out. Snow coming: White Pass gets 18 in at 5,500 ft and the Mount Rainier backcountry 50 in at 6,919 ft by Sunday, NWAC has no rating posted. Best ski day: The Tatoosh on Friday, good weather window until about 2 PM, then heavy snow, NWAC has no rating posted.
hike: Rain and snow move through the mountains Thursday and Friday, and Saturday turns dry. Best hike day: Hurricane Ridge on Friday, good weather window all day, through 10 PM, NWAC has no rating posted.
